reviews.title: Beware!!!! Horrible billing issues
reviews.text:
Check Your Subscription Carefully

I discovered that I had been charged for a RiseGuide subscription since February 2026 even though I had never used the app or course and was unaware I had an active subscription. My account showed an introductory charge of $19.99 followed by $41.99 every four weeks, totaling $355.91 by the time I discovered it.

What was especially concerning to me was that I could not find a single email from RiseGuide in my email account—no welcome email, enrollment confirmation, purchase receipt, renewal notice, or billing receipt.

When I contacted support and requested a refund, I repeatedly asked for records specific to my enrollment and account activity. Instead, I received explanations of their general checkout process and subscription terms. After completing their requested refund form, I was offered a new $9.99-every-four-weeks subscription instead. When I declined and reiterated my refund request, I was told a full refund was not possible and offered 50% of only my most recent payment.

This has been an extremely disappointing experience. I strongly recommend that anyone using this service carefully review the subscription terms, monitor recurring charges, and retain documentation of the signup and cancellation process.

reviews.title: SCAM company
reviews.text:
I consider RiseGuide a scam. The app was trash, and after I canceled last month and deleted my account, I was charged $41.99 anyway. I checked my App Store subscriptions, and RiseGuide wasn’t listed there.

The app has a “Cancel Your Account” button, but using it apparently does not cancel the paid subscription. You have to cancel separately through their website. That distinction was not clear to me when I signed up, and it cost me $41.99. It feels like a setup designed to profit from people who reasonably think they’ve already canceled.

RiseGuide has shown me no reason to trust this company. If you use it, do not assume deleting your account stops the billing. Cancel through the website and keep proof. I’m demanding my refund and warning others so they don’t get charged the way I did.

reviews.title: $149.99 - updated review
reviews.text:
I originally had a very frustrating experience with RiseGuide after being charged $149.99 for a subscription I had completely forgotten about and had never actually used. I also found it unnecessarily difficult to locate any account or subscription information within the app, which made the unexpected charge even more frustrating.

After contacting the company, however, I eventually reached customer service that was responsive and willing to work with me. They confirmed that my subscription was fully canceled and offered a 50% refund, which I have now received.

I’m giving 4 stars specifically for how customer service ultimately handled the situation. They were professional, courteous, and followed through on what they promised.

I can’t really review the actual app or its content because I never used it, so my rating is based on my experience resolving the billing issue. While I still think the subscription and account information should be much clearer and easier to access, I appreciate that they ultimately worked with me to reach a reasonable resolution.
